prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Miami for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” orthodontist for everyone — the right doctor depends on your needs (age, complexity), preferences (metal braces vs clear/lingual braces vs Invisalign), budget, and whether you prefer a doctor who’s highly experienced with Invisalign or with complex surgical cases.

How to find the best orthodontist in Miami for you
- Choose a board-certified orthodontist: look for a specialist who completed an orthodontic residency (not a general dentist offering braces) and, if possible, is a Diplomate of the American Board of Orthodontics (ABO).  
- Verify Invisalign experience if you want clear aligners: Invisalign has levels (Preferred/Gold/Platinum/Elite/Diamond) that indicate case volume/experience — higher tiers generally mean more experience with aligners. You can search Invisalign’s provider locator.  
- Check reviews and before/after photos: Google, Yelp, Healthgrades, RealSelf, and the practice’s website/Instagram often show results and patient feedback.  
- Ask about technology and process: digital scanning (no goopy impressions), 3D treatment planning, in-house or lab-made appliances, clear aligner expertise, and follow-up/retainer policy.  
- Compare cost, financing, and insurance: ask for full treatment estimates, what’s included (retainers, emergency visits), and monthly-payment options.  
- Meet for consultations: most offices offer free/low-cost consults — compare two or three doctors to see whom you trust and who explains options clearly.

Practical resources
- American Association of Orthodontists (AAO) “Find an Orthodontist”
- Invisalign provider locator (to find experienced Invisalign doctors)
- Google/Yelp/Healthgrades for local reviews

Typical costs and timeline (Miami area ballpark)
- Traditional braces: ~ $3,000–$7,000.  
- Invisalign / clear aligners: ~ $3,000–$8,000 (depends on case complexity).  
- Typical treatment time: 12–24 months for many cases; simpler aligner cases can be shorter.

If you want, I can:
- Look up top-rated orthodontists in Miami and list a short, vetted shortlist (I’ll include credentials, Invisalign status, addresses, and links) — tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood and whether this is for an adult or a child.  
- Or draft a list of questions to ask at consultations.
